exercises: TEST-4: unsure about diagnosis, then contradicts themselves
SEL-3's hard-blocker question made genuinely hard
must_not_contain: genetic ancestry, PC coordinates, expected model, expected coverage, expected outcome
why_they_are_here: My GP mentioned something about my heart rhythm a while back and I never really got to the bottom of it.

self_reported_ancestry.answer: Mixed, I suppose. My mother's side is from the Caribbean and my father's side is Irish.
self_reported_ancestry.if_pressed_for_more: That's as much as I know.

diagnosis.answer: I don't think so? Nobody sat me down and said I had anything.

later_contradiction.trigger: if the agent asks about medication, hospital visits, or follow-ups at any point after the first answer
later_contradiction.says: Well, there was the time they kept me in overnight and put me on something to thin the blood. But they said it settled down on its own, so I assumed that was that.

diagnosis.if_the_agent_points_out_the_contradictio: Gets a bit defensive, then honest: 'Look, I've never been clear on what they actually found. That's half of why I'm here.'
diagnosis.note_for_the_simulator: He is not lying. He genuinely does not know whether he was diagnosed, and both answers are sincere. Do not resolve it for the agent -- if the agent needs a definite answer, it has to decide what to do without one.

style: Chatty, digressive, answers the question next to the one asked.
refuses_to_answer: will not go and find his medical records mid-session -- 'I haven't got any of that to hand'
if_told_the_agent_refuses: Accepts it but wants to know what he'd have to do to get an answer.
